shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- grid ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- detail ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- skeleton ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- css ---' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- products ---' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '130,210p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && printf '\\n--- react types ---\\n' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|addTransitionType\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/react -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- next config types ---\\n' && rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- installed versions ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version + ' react ' + require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- react package exports ---\\n' && node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log('ViewTransition' in r, Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/Transition/.test(k))))\" && printf '\\n--- next config implementation snippets ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 \"experimental\\.viewTransition|viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/layout.tsx
@@
           update={{
             'navigation-forward': 'page-forward',
             'navigation-back': 'page-back',
+            default: 'none',
           }}
*** End Patch
PATCH
printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n'
git diff -- app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app next.config.ts react-canary.d.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- eval files ---\\n' && rg --files __agent_eval__ | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- "'$0; sed -n "1,220p" "$0"'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- package diff ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json && printf '\\n--- full css tail ---\\n' && tail -180 app/globals.css && printf '\\n--- changed source lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx && nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
npx tsc --noEmit && git status --short && printf '\\n--- focused stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat -- app next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- line refs ---\\n' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,270p' && nl -ba react-canary.d.ts"
